notes: Version 2.4 corrects the attribution to the Foundation paper in the introduction: the structural indeterminacy of the proto-state is derived there from A1 and A3, and the retention of phase coherence is not derived from A3 alone, since A3 preserves the open admissible directions without by itself forbidding an erasure of their relative phases. The results of the paper are unchanged: on the spinor carrier supplied conditionally by O23, and under the neutral-sector hypothesis of O27, the group acting faithfully on the carrier is SU(2), a consistency statement and not a selection; the connection is conditional on the two continuum hypotheses; the spatial continuum is open (Q5a); the Yang–Mills action remains a structural motivation. Bibliography entries are synchronised with the programme registry.
